## Open a New HELOC at an Introductory Rate


Virginia National Bank can help homeowners tap into funds by opening a Home Equity Line of Credit (HELOC). Whether you are looking to make a major purchase, do a home renovation, or want to consolidate debt, find out if you are eligible to open a line of credit with your home's equity.


### Learn more about HELOC and personal loan products offered at VNB[here](https://www.vnb.com/products/loans/personal-loans) .


Listen to VNB's **[podcast episode](https://www.vnb.com/blog/detail/home-equity-line-of-credit-heloc)** with VNB's Chief Banking Officer, Gina Bayes, and Chief Credit Officer, Caleb Moore, discussing what a HELOC is and if you qualify.


****


*Rates above as of 11/18/2026 and subject to change.*


*1APR During the Introductory Period: The variable introductory Annual Percentage Rate (“APR”) is based upon The Wall Street Journal Prime Rate (“Prime”) minus a discount of 1.51%. Prime may change at any time and is subject to change without notice. If Prime increases or decreases during the Introductory Period, the variable Introductory APR and minimum required payment will correspondingly change. The Introductory Period begins on the date of account opening and is in effect for 9 months (“the Introductory Period”).* *2APR After the Introductory Period: After the Introductory Period ends, any and all remaining balances will automatically convert to the variable APR per the terms of your Home Equity Line of Credit (“HELOC”) Agreement and Disclosure. The term of a HELOC is 25 years. APRs are variable during the 10-year draw period and 15-year repayment period and are based on your credit line amount, combined Loan-To-Value (CLTV) ratio and other factors; and can range from Prime + 0.25% (currently 7.25% APR) to Prime + 2.00% (currently 9.00% APR). During the 15-year repayment period, the APR will continue to be calculated at a variable rate and your minimum monthly payment will be 1/180th of the total balance at the end of the draw period, plus interest and any applicable fees/charges. Your APR will not exceed 16% or go below 3.25% at any time during the term of your account.* *Virginia National Bank will pay up to $2,000 toward closing costs. If you terminate your account within 36 months of opening it, you will be required to remit any closing costs the Bank paid on your behalf.* *This offer is subject to credit approval and is based on a minimum equity line amount of $25,000 with a maximum combined loan-to-value of 80%. This offer is limited to an owner-occupied single-family residential property. You must carry property insurance on the property that secures the loan. Offer subject to change without notice at any time.* *The interest rate on your Home Equity Line of Credit may be tax deductible. Consult your tax advisor regarding deductibility of interest.*
